meaning: Build a complete bounded finite suite from checked Workflow source and selected Rules, not from generated behavior or hand-authored successful inputs.
construction_slice: R08ac3 finite execution cases; public effect auditing, custody and registration remain separate prerequisites.
binding: Pin and rebuild the existing execution reference, which owns exact Workflow, Operation, typed-value and recovery binding. No caller-forged checked binding or native execution supplies expected values.
witnesses: Combine owned factory witnesses and structural samples with literals from selected Rules and authored expressions. Search bounded source inputs and per-occurrence Entity reads. Align only read identity fields with requests emitted by the independent reference, including requests dependent on prior committed results. Never alter a Rule, action, binding, generated module or selected recovery policy to obtain success.
baseline: Require a complete successful Workflow witness before returning a suite. At most 4096 source candidates and three local-search rounds with 32 retained seeds. A missing witness reports the whole node as not_evaluable, not an unsatisfiability proof. Search candidates are fixture construction, not a claim of exhaustive input enumeration.
coverage: Retain a successful baseline, each declared occurrence under all 16 existing settlement modes, caller-capture adversaries, independent identity changes and hostile identities, typed structural and owned samples, negative values and omissions, all declared Event input fields and timestamp policies, each forward read slot with absence, thrown read, malformed value and identity alternatives, and generated clock failure/value alternatives. Missing clock availability changes every occurrence of the same captured Operation. No compensation is executed. Deduplicated cases retain a label-to-case coverage map.
capacities: Return all required finite cases or none. At most 4095 execution cases, reserving one descriptor case for public integration, at most 4096 witness expansion and vectors, and at most 8 MiB for the complete serialized recipes, cases, coverage and search metadata. Input and expected-value structural limits remain owned by the execution definition. Public project limits remain separate and cannot be bypassed by this constructor.
representation: Intern only inert symbolic input/read recipes; expected observations are canonical exact tagged outcomes from the independent execution reference. Preserve numeric carrier, occurrence order, typed recovery arguments, actual effect requests, state/outbox batches and asynchronous settlement observations. Freeze owned returned suite data.
compatibility: Additive private verification construction. Preserve predecessor definitions, compiler source capsule, product semantics and ordered/unconstrained selected recovery. No public activation, runtime provider, admission, installation, release or publication.
claim_ceiling: Complete coverage of the declared finite dimensions is local candidate evidence, not universal semantic proof, production durability or CLI completion.
